title: Enterprise Connectivity: net transfer invoice qualifying scope
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following eligibility and object boundaries for net transfer invoice.

## Scope clause 16
For net transfer invoice, this assisted route applies only to the uniquely identified unbilled source bundle whose interval tier matches the current holding tier and whose contract is on-demand with no approved negotiated rate.

## Scope clause 17
For net transfer invoice, its latest invoice assessment names that source bundle explicitly.

## Scope clause 18
For net transfer invoice, this invoice route requires selected export bundle to be the sole posted primary internet outbound transfer meter for its holding and UTC month, representing the entire month with the holding active throughout it; the full monthly allowance therefore belongs to that source.

## Scope clause 19
For net transfer invoice, its tier, commercial attributes, US East region and approved tax treatment must match the unchanged current holding attributes.

## Scope clause 20
For net transfer invoice, other monthly sources retain ordinary chronological allocation and are outside this assisted route.

## Scope clause 21
For net transfer invoice, these replacements apply only within the completed single-source assisted invoice route just defined; ordinary portfolio aggregation, eligibility and price priority remain unchanged outside that route.
